Rain Alert Issued for Multiple Cities in India

A low-pressure system is expected to bring multiple spells of rain to various cities across India, prompting weather warnings from the Indian Meteorological Department. The rain is likely to affect Delhi, Chandigarh, Punjab, Rajasthan, and Jharkhand on Friday. The IMD has issued a yellow alert for these regions, indicating that heavy showers are possible.
